remainingScopeReason: Reviewed all remaining units against the bound input support contract. CERT_P12_CONTAINER remains a legacy filename/container signal on encrypted, malformed and unencrypted P12/PFX files; its presence does not require attribute extraction. The added unencrypted certificate-only P12/PFX containers have visible Data/certificate-bag encodings and explicit -certpbe NONE/-nomac conversion provenance, within the public subset. PEM/DER attributes remain hash-bound public certificate facts. Already ambiguous/unsupported source, malformed, unknown-property and Swift cases retain their original exclusion scope. Other source/config/dependency/SBOM/marker units retain their defined nominal scope rather than a runtime/execution assurance. No other scope conflict found.

dispositions.reason: The public-only PKCS12/PFX bytes contain an encryptedData ContentInfo (OID 1.2.840.113549.1.7.6 at byte 38). Conversion provenance identifies the originating public RSA certificate, but the documented supported subset excludes encrypted contents and pkcs12.rs content() returns no decoded object for non-Data content. Therefore this CERT_ECDSA_SIGNATURE attribute is outside supported extraction, independently of whether its original certificate fact is known.
